global.question: Are tours private?
global.answer: Yes. Hai Sri Lanka specializes in private inbound experiences for couples, families, and small groups. You travel with your own driver guide, not on a mixed coach.

global.question: Do you arrange airport transfers?
global.answer: Yes. Airport welcomes and departures can be included with any multi day itinerary or booked separately.

global.question: How do I book?
global.answer: Select a tour, choose travelers and date, submit traveler details, and you will receive email confirmation. No online payment is required to request a booking.

global.question: Can itineraries be customized?
global.answer: Absolutely. We adjust pace, hotels, and experiences to your preferences before confirming your journey.

global.question: When do I pay?
global.answer: You pay at destination after your tour is confirmed. We do not take card payments online to request a booking.

global.question: What is your cancellation policy?
global.answer: Free cancellation is available on most tours if you notify us in reasonable time before travel. Exact terms are confirmed with your booking email.

global.question: What is usually included?
global.answer: Private vehicle, driver guide, fuel, and parking are typically included. Tickets, meals, and hotels depend on the tour and are listed on each tour page.

global.question: How far in advance should I book?
global.answer: Two to four weeks is comfortable for day tours. Multi day journeys and peak months (December to March and July to August) are better booked earlier.

global.question: Do you take children or solo travelers?
global.answer: Yes. Families and solo travelers are welcome. Tell us ages and pace so we can shape a comfortable private day.

global.question: Which languages do guides speak?
global.answer: English is standard. German, French, and other European languages can often be arranged on request.

items.question: Do you offer private Sri Lanka tours?
items.answer: Yes. Every Hai Sri Lanka tour is private, your vehicle and English speaking driver guide, not a mixed group bus. Day tours and multi day vacation packages can be tailored to your dates.

items.question: What is included in a Sri Lanka tour package?
items.answer: Private transport, fuel, parking, and a driver guide are typically included. Multi day packages often include 4 star hotels. Entrance tickets and meals depend on the itinerary and are listed on each tour page.

items.question: Which places in Sri Lanka do your tours visit?
items.answer: Popular travel places include Sigiriya, Dambulla, Kandy, Ella, Yala, Mirissa, Galle Fort, Bentota, and Colombo. We also tailor routes around the places you most want to see.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: Hai Sri Lanka Tours is based in Colombo and operates private journeys across the island.

items.question: How do I contact you quickly?
items.answer: Use the contact form, email, phone, or WhatsApp. We reply personally and help shape dates around your trip.
